about.metaDescription: Why exposé exists and how it differs from general classifieds.
about.title: Used camera gear without the guesswork.
about.intro: exposé is a place in Lithuania to buy and sell used cameras, lenses and accessories. We built it because finding the right camera among thousands of ads for everything else was too hard.
about.photoAlt: A mirror photo with a camera

why.title: Why we exist
why.lead: In Lithuania, used gear is sold on general classifieds, where a camera sits next to a bike and a sofa. The same two problems keep coming up there.

names.title: One model, ten names
names.text: Every seller writes the model their own way: “fuji xt3”, “Fujifilm XT-3”, “X T3 camera”. Search does not connect them, so searching for “X-T3” misses half the ads.

details.title: The important part is missing
details.text: Most ads have only a photo and a price. Shutter count, whether everything works, whether the charger and box are included - you have to ask in messages.

different.title: What we do differently
different.lead: An ad here is built from a clear structure, not free text. So every ad answers the same questions.

catalog.title: A model from the catalog
catalog.text: Sellers pick the model from a list instead of typing a name. Every ad for the same camera ends up in one place.

questions.title: The questions buyers ask
questions.text: Shutter count, cosmetic and functional condition separately, a clear list of what is included - all visible at once.

gearOnly.title: Camera gear only
gearOnly.text: No sofas or bikes. Cameras, lenses and accessories - from people who actually shot with them.

now.title: A small project with big plans
now.early: exposé is an early pilot. There is no big company behind it: it is built by a photography fan in Vilnius, in their spare time.
now.catalog: We fill the catalog gradually. Can't find your model? Add it by name - we will review it and add it. Later we want to build a community here too: forums, chats, photo sharing.

cta.title: Got gear gathering dust?
cta.description: You create an ad in a few minutes - no title to come up with.
